title: Closing Desk Table: Unpaid Tolerance Cures Credited on a Mortgage Loan File Closing Disclosure
content:
Tolerance cures owed to the borrower on a Mortgage Loan File enter the initial Closing Disclosure as a lender credit, read from the file's tolerance cure history: each assessed cure, its cure method (a credit at closing or a post-closing refund), and any payment booked against it. The unpaid amount of a group of cures is their assessed amounts less the amounts paid against them.

**Rule.** Where tolerance cures with the cure method of a credit at closing are assessed on the file and not yet paid, their unpaid amount is added; where no such entry is open but tolerance cures with the cure method of a post-closing refund are assessed on the file and not yet paid, their unpaid amount is moved onto the Closing Disclosure and added; otherwise nothing is added.

| Open credit-at-closing cures | Open post-closing-refund cures | Added to the lender credits |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the unpaid amount of the credit-at-closing cures |
| no | yes | the unpaid amount of the post-closing-refund cures, moved onto the Closing Disclosure |
| no | no | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical tolerance cure histories)

- A zero-tolerance cure of 412.50 USD assessed as a credit at closing, nothing paid: 412.50 USD is added.
- A credit-at-closing cure of 412.50 USD assessed and fully paid, and a post-closing-refund cure of 60.00 USD assessed and unpaid: no credit-at-closing cure is open, so the 60.00 USD is moved onto the Closing Disclosure and added.
- No assessed cure on the file: nothing is added.
